name: Keanu Reeves Dating Sim
source:
On your way home from an out of town business trip, your car breaks down in a strange town filled with men that look nearly identical to each other. Will you find help and get out of down, or does your destiny have something different in mind?

This is a game where you can meet and date different versions of the best actor of all time, Keanu Reeves.

[from itch.io]
